chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about the men and the women: how is the prayer to be performed over them? He said: The men are placed in front of the women, in the area nearest to the Imam, arranged in a row one after another.

key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: the male deceased for whom the funeral prayer is being arranged
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: the female deceased in the shared funeral arrangement
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader who stands in relation to the جنازة arrangement
key_terms.يُصَفُّ: they are lined up or arranged in order
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ: the funeral prayer is performed over them

ai.seo_question: How should the funeral prayer be arranged when the جنا‌ئز of men and women are gathered together?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the arrangement of the biers of men and women when the funeral prayer is performed over them together. It states that the men are placed closest to the Imam, with their bodies lined up one after another ahead of the women.
